description: Create a new inbound inbox in a folder. Omit `domain_id` for a Mailtrap-hosted inbox; pass it for a custom-domain (catch-all) inbox.

domain_id.description: Optional. Attach the inbox to a custom sending domain (catch-all inbox). Omit for a standard Mailtrap-hosted inbox.

folder_id.description: The inbound folder ID to create the inbox in.

name: create-inbound-inbox
